key_insight: GrowRL turns RL updates into explicit, reusable Transformer pathways by freezing the backbone and training only newly added attention and feed-forward branches.
engineering_relevance: This makes RL adaptation more parameter-efficient and transferable, so one expensive reasoning training run can be reused across compatible LLMs.
method: Freeze the pretrained backbone and add a causal-attention branch plus a feed-forward branch at each Transformer layer.
Zero-initialize output projections so the model initially matches the pretrained policy, then update only the added pathways with RL.
Keep the learned pathways explicit for transfer to target models, with support for sequential transfer of additional pathways.
evidence_signal: Across five backbones, the method reports competitive mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution performance with few trainable parameters, and target-side transfer is already close after 10 updates versus 100.
watch_item: Transfer requires structural compatibility between source and target models, and the added branching may complicate implementation and deployment.
paper_title: Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning
